structured_output.what_is_happening: "Leaf" is one of at least 10 pump.fun coins with the same name, all launched within a few minutes of each other around 04:05 UTC. They seem to be riding the Leaf launchpad (leafdot.fun, @Leafdotfun_). That platform launches pump.fun coins paired with tokenized stocks and splits creator fees 45% to an X creator, 45% to stock holders and 10% to the launchpad. This coin's GeckoTerminal social link points to a Leafdotfun_ status post. The coin graduated to PumpSwap within about 13 minutes. It now sits around $20.8k mcap, about 24% below its ATH. Flow is extremely one-sided: 1,804 unique buyers against only 53 sellers.

narrative.description: The Leaf launchpad ('creator fees to X, stock to holders') seems to be launching now or getting attention, and a swarm of coins named 'Leaf' was deployed to front-run or copy it.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely a launchpad announcement tweet set off a copycat rush of launches. I found no organic discussion of this particular contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only link is a social field pointing to a Leafdotfun_ tweet, which any deployer can set. The site lists no official contract.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 9 other 'Leaf' coins were launched in the same few minutes. EKXP724f... was created earlier than this one and has more volume (about $426k in the last hour, $39.6k mcap). A1dBwt... is at $225k mcap. Several others already have near-zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 39 bundler wallets holding 21.8% of top traders. There is a 44-wallet insider trade network. The creator has closed their position. The 1,804 buyers vs 53 sellers split looks like bot or bundled flow. No smart-money or KOL wallets are present.
authenticity.uncertainty: The buyer/seller asymmetry could partly be early, real launchpad hype. I have no X data.

structural_risks: Price already about 24% below ATH and fading on the 5-minute chart
